sections.title: What is identified
sections.text: Knight’s bibliography lists this 1986 Design Computing article on transformations of the meander motif, pp. 29–67.

sections.title: What cannot yet be summarized
sections.text: The title identifies the subject but does not establish the corpus, transformation operations, methodology or findings. Those details require the original article.

sections.title: How to continue
sections.text: Use the citation to request the article through a library. Do not substitute findings from the similarly titled chapter in the later book without checking the versions.
